notes.title: Patch 3.6
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have a few things to announce. We'll start with a basic summary then go into detail.

Updates to Glass Heart:

1. Will's Animation has been added. (For those who have completed his route - You may need to play through his good ending again to unlock the animation. You can do this by going to Extras - Chapters -Will - GE)
2. The Text Message Speed glitch has been fixed! 
3. We are hoping that the lagging has been resolved for most players. 

Important Notice: Lagging may still be present for some desktops and laptops - specifically older models and lower RAM models.

Details:

We have been trying to resolve the lagging issue that has been brought to our attention by a few of our players. We have searched extensively for a solution, including hiring programmers from outside our team to assist with this. No one has been able to replicate the lagging issue; however, our search has given us some answers. Glass Heart uses HTML.5/Javascript programming. With the amount of audio files, special effects and art assets, it uses a substantial amount of memory to load scenes. This can cause some laptops and desktops to have an increased loading time during scene transitions. This can also lead to lagging and freezing. We have tried to minimize this by compressing all art assets in the game. However, we made sure to compress in a way that will not affect the image quality. This should decrease the workload for most computers, not all. 

We apologize to those who have experienced lagging. We want all of our players to enjoy playing our game. This issue did not present itself during Alpha or Beta testing. As such, we were unaware of the limitations of the engine and coding language that we were using. However, we have learned from this experience. For our future games, we will be programming with a coding language that can adequately handle the load that our games have. We will continue to try and search for ways to limit the lag for those who may still experience some after this update. We thank you so much for your patience and hope that you enjoy Glass Heart.

-Eternal Love Studios Team

notes.title: Patch Updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've updated the following:

1. Meira's UI - Cleaned and fixed a bug on her UI sprite
2. Cleaned the sliders on the settings menu
3. Decrease the transition timing (Please let us know if you still encounter issues with slow load transitions)
4. Spacebar now hides the UI and message box when pressed during the game.

If you encounter bugs, please let us know on our discord or in the discussions forum under "Report bugs or errors". This way we can remedy these as quickly as possible.

Thank you so much for playing Glass Heart! We appreciate each and every one of you.

notes.title: Update on Animated Sequences
notes.notes:
1. Jay's Animated Movie has been updated.
2. Brayson's Animated Movie has been added.
3. Movies page has been updated.

Both of the animated sequences are unlockable so be sure to play through the game and check the Movie's page to see if they are unlocked!

We are extremely excited to have the talented, Allyson J. Barroga, as the voice of Meira in the animated sequences!

More to come soon!

notes.title: Major Update - CG Gallery
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've noticed a few bugs in our previous CG Gallery and decided to update it. 

We've added the following features:
1. CG Moment Playback - Click the play button to revisit your favorite CG moments!
2. Right Click to erase the back button and the play button in order to view the CG without any distractions.
3. Bugs Fixed - Freezing when clicking on a CG containing multiple variations.

We hope that you enjoy this new CG Gallery!

Thank you for playing Glass Heart!

notes.title: Patch 2.3
notes.notes:
It was brought to our attention that there were still moments when the MC would appear behind the message box. We have been working to revise this issue. We are hoping that this latest patch will resolve this issue and apologize for any inconvenience.

If you encounter this error, after this update, please let us know. 

Also, we plan to upload two animated sequences in the next week so keep a look out for that patch!

Thank you for playing Glass Heart!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Thank you for playing Glass Heart! We hope that you are enjoying the game!

We have updated the font color on the text box so that it is easier to read. 

Please note, if you have any save files(prior to this patch), the old font color may be present during that specific scene. It will automatically correct itself as soon as you change to the next scene.
